import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])

    if k == 0:
        ans = pow(p, p - 1, MOD)
        print(ans)
        return

    vis = [False] * p
    ans = 1

    for i in range(p):
        if not vis[i]:
            cur = i
            length = 0
            while not vis[cur]:
                vis[cur] = True
                cur = (cur * k) % p
                length += 1
            w = pow(k, length, p)
            if w == 1:
                ans = (ans * p) % MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
